police_check.title: Police Checkpoint
police_check.description: Red and blue lights flash ahead. A stern officer signals you to pull over.
police_check.flavour: They say they're looking for someone. Best to stay calm.

broken_down_car.title: Stranded Motorist
broken_down_car.description: A beat-up sedan sits on the shoulder, hood popped. The driver looks desperate.
broken_down_car.flavour: The desert is no place to be stuck without a radiator.

rest_stop.title: Roadside Oasis
rest_stop.description: A small diner and a couple of rusty pumps. It's not much, but it's a break.
rest_stop.flavour: The coffee smells like burnt rubber, but at least it's hot.

gas_station.title: Fuel & Snacks
gas_station.description: The last stop for a hundred miles.
gas_station.flavour: Pay first, then pump. Same as it ever was.

flat_tire.title: Bad Luck
flat_tire.description: A sudden POP and the car pulls hard to the left.
flat_tire.flavour: Always at the worst possible time.

hitchhiker.title: Roadside Hitchhiker
hitchhiker.description: A figure stands by the road, thumb out. They look like they've been waiting for a while.
hitchhiker.flavour: Everyone has a story. Some are just longer than others.

hitchhikers.name: The Songwriter
hitchhikers.description: Wears a faded denim jacket. Carries a guitar case.

NEW.name: Upbeat Tune
NEW.description: Hums a catchy melody. Restores 10 sanity.

conversations: This road reminds me of home.
I used to have a band back in the city.
Nothing big, just local dives and the occasional wedding.
But the drummer... well, he found a real job. And the bassist moved to the coast.
Now it's just me and this old guitar, looking for a new sound.
Bayside has the best sunsets.
You ever feel like you're just a character in someone else's song?
Like you're just following the chords they laid down years ago...
Sometimes I think if I play loud enough, I can break the rhythm.
Wanna hear the new verse?

hitchhikers.name: The Stranger
hitchhikers.description: No destination given. Stares at the road.

COMPLICATED.name: The Weight
COMPLICATED.drawback: You don't want to know how they did it.

conversations: I knew you'd stop.
The mirrors in this car... they're not just for the road.
The past is always following us, right there in the glass.
Most people keep their eyes forward so they don't have to see it.
But you... you keep checking them. You're looking for something.
Don't look in the mirror.
There's a place where the highway just... ends.
No sign, no barrier. Just a sudden lack of asphalt.
I've been there twice. Once going south, once going nowhere.
We're headed in that general direction.
They can't follow here.

hitchhikers.name: The Hiker
hitchhikers.description: Backpack, boots, wonder in their eyes.

COMPLICATED.name: Detour
COMPLICATED.description: Avoids danger but adds 20km to route.
COMPLICATED.drawback: The long way around is exhausting.

conversations: Nice weather today.
I've been walking since the border.
People ask why I don't just take the bus, but they miss the details.
The way the light hits the sagebrush at dawn... you can't see that from a window.
Well, technically we're looking through a window now, but you know what I mean!
I like this song.
Did you see that hawk back there?
It was riding the thermals, barely moving its wings.
Sometimes I wish I could just do that. Just float above the highway...
But then I'd missing out on meeting interesting drivers like you.
